trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly — it is the reward for finishing the whole list. Plan on around 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Everything is single-player and offline, there are no difficulty trophies, and one playthrough is enough, so follow the roadmap stages in order and let this land last.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Finish A Long Road (100% completion) — it is the last gate before this pops.
trophies.when: After every other trophy is earned

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game, and the last gate before the platinum. The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It does not ask for everything: required in full are all robberies (including the 8 bank vaults and the 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. The rest is a share: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work the checklist top to bottom after the credits; the 11 trophies flagged 100% Critical in this guide are the ones that feed it.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear every full-requirement line: all robberies, 8 vaults, 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, all shooting-range golds, all drone races, 15 Target Decks.
Fill the shared lines to their targets: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies, 15 meditations, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.
trophies.where: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (appears after the story)
trophies.when: After the credits; work done earlier already counts

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track your count under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and turn on the map's Stunt Spots to plan routes. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300, so this trophy is 100% critical.
steps: Turn on Stunt Spots on the map.
Chain under-the-bridge flights and stunt jumps; any mix counts.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts; stop at 250 for the trophy, 300 for 100%.
trophies.when: Any time; count carries across the whole game

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, Activities shows what is left, so check it first and only do the types you have not touched. Most of these come naturally while you play, which is why this trophy often pops on its own during cleanup — if it has not, the Activities screen tells you exactly which type is missing.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see which types are untried.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds in total across the ranges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them, and the gold thresholds are per-challenge, so a weak weapon or a rushed run will cost you; take your time, use the range's best weapon for each challenge, and retry the ones you silver. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so do this before you attempt that trophy. Every gold is also required in full by the 100% checklist.

Earn gold in all 42 challenges across the ranges.
Retry any silver until it turns gold.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot until the counter reaches 18. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner every time. The last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE WARNING: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony of Jason's house and accept her meditation — it is gone after Chapter 1, there is no mission replay, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. This is the only trophy in the game that can be locked out, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 spots, so meditation is 100% critical too.
steps: Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. Do this FIRST — it disappears after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, so if you are already buying weapons and modding cars, this will climb on its own. There is no need to waste money: just route your normal spending through shops, and if you are close at the end, finish it off with a car mod or a tattoo you actually want.
steps: Spend across shops as you play — guns, car mods and tattoos count fastest.
Reach $100,000 in total spending.
trophies.when: Any time; running total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, so you have to buy all eight yourself. Garages are also practical — On the Spot needs free garage space for registrations — so buy them early and the rest of the list gets easier. All garages are one of the pieces A Long Road needs, so this trophy is 100% critical.
steps: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy all 8 garages for sale (about $160,000 total).
trophies.where: Vice City Real Estate app (after Daily Driver, Chapter 2)
trophies.when: From Chapter 2 onwards

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes rather than expensive finds.
steps: Do Moses' Chapter 2 mission to get the Scooter Bros app.
Take a stolen vehicle to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray it, then register it.
Repeat for 10 vehicles — use cheap cars and bikes, and keep free garage space.
trophies.where: Moses' garage, Port Gellhorn; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray
trophies.when: From Chapter 2 onwards
